scope: Separate discarded four-arm fresh-model optimization test. All arms share learned FP32 residual multiplier1/32, unchanged physical bilinear skip/output/loss units and capacity. Same seed51/zero-head initial weights and all16 exact initial bilinear outputs; original852 tensors. Replace only four input RAW features with original RAW, gain32, or fixed local7/31 same-CFA-phase reflected highpass times32. Other28 variance/CFA/WB/matrix features unchanged. No image-derived scaling/min-max/statistical normalization, learned inverse, per-crop global statistic, interpolation or new parameters. Local mean filtering deliberately removes DC from those four neural features; the physical signal skip remains, and local padding adds context dependence. Same16 frozen training-only B4 batches, 64 observations/noise/order,256 constant-LR2e-4 fresh AdamW updates, clip1 and original domain losses. CUDA IEEE FP32 NCHW, no AMP/TF32. No GFX/holdout/protected-final optimization, pretrained initializer, new training-source admission, learned-weight export, production change, quality promotion, speed or convergence claim. Previous CUDA test is complete and process-exited; isolated CPU test continues unchanged. No automatic restart.
decision: No production adoption or trained-model quality claim. Local7/31 filtering slightly improves native/paired original loss versus input gain32 at common1/32 residual units, but is worse on Commons loss/MSE and native MSE. Local-filter MSE gains over initialization are small; no single arm is best across all domain losses/MSE. All learned weights are discarded. This256-update repeated-fixture experiment is neither a convergence verdict nor generalization evidence.
